TEST LOG 914-D — D-CLASS EXPENDITURE RECORD

Test 44: Input: one (1) pocket watch, damaged. Setting: 1:1. Output: one (1) pocket watch, functional, wrong time. The time it shows is always 03:47.

Test 51: Input: one (1) 9V battery. Setting: VERY FINE. Output:
one (1) object, battery-shaped, mass 0.4 kg over input. Powers devices indefinitely. Devices so powered report a second set of readings from an adjacent room that does not exist.
one (1) D-Class subject (D-8804), against protocol, on the Director's verbal order. Setting: FINE. Output: [REMAINDER OF ENTRY SEALED BY O5 DIRECTIVE]
